_comment: Hand-authored schema fixes applied, in order, over the extractor's output: each entry names a record, an op (replace, insert_after, append), a path of member sigs/names ('element' enters an array element; [] is the record itself), the node (a list inserts or appends several), and the reason xEdit's definition doesn't match the game data. The parity audit applies the same entries, so every divergence from xEdit is one of these.

xEdit names this struct 'Unknown' verbatim (wbDefinitionsFO76.pas: wbStruct(DATA, 'Unknown', [...])) even though every field is fully decoded — Value/Min Level/Special/Race Restriction. Renamed here so it stops reading as an undecoded blob. Race Restriction (offset 6) is the race-eligibility byte: 0=None, 1=Human, 2=Ghoul.

wbPerkEffect is a HARD_RAW_VAR (runtime Pascal decider) — extractor cannot statically resolve the Effect element. This hand-authored rstruct has been validated against real ESM data. All other PERK members (EDID, DURL, VMAD, FULL, DESC, ICON, Conditions, Data, SNAM, PRFS, NNAM, FNAM, PRFI, PFAC) come from native extraction.

PGTR — whole-record override: no TES5Edit definition exists (every wbDefinitions*.pas in the pinned checkout and its full history; EcksEdit 4.1.6.18 still crashes on PGTR per fwdekker/fo76-dumps). Shape read off the 4 WorldPets_ProgressionTrack_* records in 20260903 (581 subrecords each: 30 entries, 32 rewards). Field names come from the game's own UI model in interface/petprogressiontrackmenu.swf (Shared/ProgressionNode.as, PetProgressionTrackMenu.as); members that model doesn't name stay 'Unknown' with the observed constant recorded, not guessed. Form Tags (FTAG 'WorldPets') follows EDID from 20260928 (fv 211).

members._comment: PGT1 — resolves to the WorldPets_Img_<species> KYWDs (0x0092736F..72); the separate WorldPets_Icon_<species> set is not referenced from PGTR.

members._comment: Track Entries — 30 per track (PGTE). Each entry opens on PGTI, so the record-trailing NAM0/NAM1 bind to the record's own members, not to a 31st entry.

members._comment: PGTI — not a FormID. A little-endian u64 key stamped by the authoring tool: contiguous within a track (Cat: 0x6A47CB50..6D), tracks 100 apart, low bits a Unix timestamp (2026-07-03). The UI's claim event sends it as {UID.hi, UID.lo} (PetProgressionTrackMenu.as:139-142; ProgressionNode.as:39 names it UID). Referenced only by sibling entries' Prerequisite Entry UID in the same record — a byte-grep of the 20260903 ESM finds each value exactly as its own PGTI plus at most one NAME.
members.name: Entry UID

This struct is NOT wbReward — wbReward's NAM7 is 'XP Amount Global' (a GLOB FormID), here NAM7 is a constant 1 — so wbReward's other names must not be imported.

members._comment: ITME x2 — xEdit uses ITME only as wbEmpty end markers (wbDefinitionsFO76.pas:7017 'Reward End Marker', :11796 and FO4 :9525 'Marker End'). The first closes the VPRI/VPRF/VPRR group, the second the reward. Both are kind 'empty', the one kind decoded with the unscoped take_first (src/decode/walk.rs), so they are matched positionally; a missing ITME would shift every later marker.
members.name: Reward Record End Marker

members._comment: NAM7 — 1 in all 128 rewards; the NAM7 names elsewhere in fo76.json belong to other structs.
members.name: Unknown 4

members._comment: NAM3 (0-byte) — present only between two rewards of the same entry (8 of 128). Deliberately 'lstring', not 'empty': 'empty' is the one kind decoded with the unscoped take_first (src/decode/walk.rs), which here stole the NEXT entry's Description Text (same sig) and corrupted every entry after the first two-reward one; lstring is element-scoped and renders the same null. Regression test: tests/decode_records/pet_tracks.rs pgtr_world_pets_radhog_track_decodes_correctly.

members.name: Unknown 4

overrides.reason: xEdit models Child Pack-In as a single GNAM/HNAM/INAM triple (wbDefinitionsFO76.pas wbRecord(PKIN)). The game writes GNAM once as a pair count, then that many HNAM (child PKIN) + INAM (its REFR list) pairs: zzz_TechTest_DB_PodCluster (0x0089ADC6, snapshot 20260914) carries GNAM=13 and 13 pairs, every HNAM naming 0x0089ADC5; xEdit's shape left 12 of them _unmapped. Single-pair PKINs (4 in 20260903) decode as a one-entry array.

xEdit leaves this as wbByteArray(QTFS, 'QTFS - Unknown 2 bytes', 2) — undecoded. Observed 0xffff ('no limit') -> 50 on the seasonal-to-repeatable quest conversion SDOW_SQ01_Graves_Repeatable (0x008F1665) in snapshot 20260710, which reads cleanly as a little-endian u16 repeat limit. Decoding the 2 bytes as one u16 is the natural low-level mapping; name hedged with '?' since the repeat-limit semantic is inferred, not confirmed. See the 'Seasonal content converts by rename' entry in patch-notes/skill/kb/mechanics.md.

MCND — live-game drift; absent from TES5Edit REFR in FO76, FO4, and SF1 (checked all three wbDefinitions*.pas). Seen only on the map-marker REFR HighwayTownMapMarker (0x007E808C), which carries 2 occurrences of 4 zero bytes. Kept as unknown/hex, wrapped in an rarray (matching NOCM's wbRArray('Unknown Datas', wbUnknown(DATA)) precedent, wbDefinitionsFO76.pas:15884) since a plain (non-array) 'unknown' member only consumes one of the 2 instances from the shared by_sig queue, leaving the second as _unmapped.

RDWC — live-game drift (snapshot 20260914, header version 293); absent from every wbDefinitions*.pas. A NUL-terminated .nif path under Sky/CubemapScenes/ (e.g. SundewGroveWeatherRegion 0x008B30A0 -> Sky/CubemapScenes/SundewGrove_CubemapScene01.nif), directly after RDWR in weather-type region data entries: 26 records, 16 distinct paths. Named after its asset directory.
NAM5 — reverse-engineered: 1 byte in test record ATX_Resource_TeaWizard_resource. Absent from TES5Edit RESO definition.

xEdit declares Start Scene's 0-byte 'End Scene Say Greeting' marker as wbEmpty(HTID). 'empty' is decoded with the unscoped take_first (src/decode/walk.rs), and HTID is also the Dialogue action's Player Headtracking and the Radio action's Play Sound, so a Start Scene action without its own marker took the next action's HTID: 90 spurious markers across 48 SCEN records in snapshot 20260914 (e.g. 0x0053AF54, whose Start Scene action at subrecords 39-46 carries no HTID), none of them a real marker. Declared 'lstring' instead: element-scoped, renders the same null.

xEdit still names this DNAM field 'Min Power Per Shot' (wbDefinitionsFO76.pas: wbFromVersion(105, wbFloat('Min Power Per Shot'))), but the engine repurposed it to the charge-weapon full-power-shot bonus (~2025) — same field, opposite name. Renamed 2026-07-14 to 'Max Power Per Shot' to fix the min/max direction, then renamed again 2026-07-15 to 'Full Power Damage Mult': 'Max' still implied a variable stat with an unstated minimum, when this is really a fixed bonus applied only at full charge. The new name pairs with the sibling field 'Full Power Seconds' (time to reach full charge) and matches the '...DamageMult' suffix used by real sibling OMOD properties (OutOfRangeDamageMult, CriticalDamageMult) — see _WEAPON_PROPERTIES in extract.py and the 'Charge weapons (Gauss family)' entry in patch-notes/skill/kb/mechanics.md.
EAMT (Enchantment Amount, u16) is absent from xEdit's WEAP definition but present in the live ESM, e.g. crDLC04AnimatronicAlienBlaster (0x00113083, form_version 205).
FTAG Form Tags — live-game drift, 20260928 (fv 211); xEdit declares wbFTAGs on 23 types, not WEAP. Observed order EDID OBND FTAG FULL, e.g. crUnarmedWorldPet_Cat 0x008E529C = 'WorldPets'.
Game data carries cloud layers 10-16 (:0TX through @0TX) between layers 9 and 17; xEdit's Cloud Textures skips those signatures, so the struct would close at layer 10 and strand layers 17-31.
